info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Healthcare Appointments Reminders-v4-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Reminder API enables healthcare providers to efficiently access and list appointment reminders for their patients. This API streamlines the management of reminders, ensuring that patients receive timely notifications about their upcoming appointments. Intended for healthcare systems, practitioners, and developers building patient engagement solutions, this API facilitates seamless integration with existing scheduling workflows. Users can benefit from improved patient attendance rates and enhanced communication through automated reminder management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch reminders for their upcoming appointments. Utilize this feature to stay informed and never miss an important meeting.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving appointment reminders. This body must be formatted as JSON and include the necessary parameters to specify the reminders to be fetched.
